study_identification_part.si_4_title: Adjustment of Regional Cortical Thickness Measures for Global Cortical Thickness Obscures Deficits Across the Schizophrenia Spectrum: A Cautionary Note About Normative Modeling of Brain Imaging Data

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Study 1 uses a single-site UCSF cohort; Study 2 uses HCP-EP (Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Study 1 included healthy control participants (HCs), participants at CHR-P, and participants with early-illness schizophrenia (ESZ) who underwent MRI scanning at the University of California San Francisco. Study 2 included HCs, participants with nonaffective psychosis (NAff-P), and participants with affective psychosis (Aff-P) who underwent MRI scanning as part of the HCP-EP (Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis)."

answer.SINGLE-SITE: HCs used to build normative model for Study 1; patient groups used for group comparisons.

answer.HCP-EP: HCs used to build normative model for Study 2; patient groups used for group comparisons.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative modeling parameters are estimated in HCs and applied to all participants regardless of group.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site (only study 2 included site) in HCs to model the effects of normal aging, gender, and site. Resulting parameter estimates were used to derive predicted ROI values for each participant, irrespective of group..."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.answer: Two normative models based on HC groups from Study 1 and Study 2.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Study 1 included 90 healthy control participants... Study 2 included 56 healthy control participants..."
